ShortDescription.Value: Auto-Clean garbage OR use Trash Boss = Self manage trucks + facilities

Publish.LongDescription:
**Magic Garbage + Trash Boss**
✅ OPTION 1, SELF MANAGE - Trash Boss - Change the load size of Garbage Trucks. - Adjsut storage, processing rate, and more trucks per facility. - Trucks can skip more side pickups on the way to their assigned stop. - Helps them arrive with room left. - Less need for extra garbage facilities in large cities. - 🚚 Great for players who still want normal game vanilla garbage service and trucks driving around; now with fewer problems.
### Assigned-target protection - Works with the game's improved garbage-truck routing. - Safely adjusts how selective trucks are with optional pickups before reaching their assigned building. - Applies settings once, then stays idle during normal gameplay.
✅ OPTION 2, AUTO CLEAN - Magic - Clears garbage automatically. - Keeps garbage warning icons away. - Mod does not stop Garbage system; cleanup is just very fast.
**11+ Languages supported** - Hello, Bonjour, Hallo, Hola, Ciao, 안녕하세요, こんにちは, Olá, Cześć, 你好, 你好, Xin chào
### Support and feedback - Enjoy! Best way to support is give it a Like (top right) it's free + easy. - Feedback on: Github, Discord, links on the right of this page.
---
### Compatibility - Safe to remove any time. - Does not use Harmony patch; designed to be lightweight for the best performance.
--- ### Bonus status report - Real stats help show what is happening. - Lean: status does not run in-city per frame; runs only in Options menu for best performance to not affect gameplay. - Compare garbage made, processed, and facility capacity. - Detailed Status writes extra info to MagicGarbage.log.
### Credits - RiverMochi - author - Thanks to Wayz for inspiration on the original Magical Garbage mod - yenyang - code review, tech advice - Gagaxm, Necko1996 - testing - Gagaxm - truck thumbnail image
Publish.ChangeLog: - Updated for game 1.6.2 - improved assigned-target protection and its garbage pickups based on new 1.6.2 updates. - Simplified controls, removed Power User, and rebalanced Recommended values. - Improved Status with clearer service capacity and request reporting.
